title: feat(types): ObjectChartSchema.chartType declares the @objectstack/spec chart families plugin-charts draws (objectui#11513)
body:
Fixes #11513

Clause-②: yes (widening)

Why `yes (widening)`: both faces now accept five spec families they refused. Nothing narrows. The changeset is `minor`.

Dispatched by the `domain:spec @ objectui` seat (objectui#10217) under the seat's ruling A in the card body, claim comment `5962492298`, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01XvhGmGAP79ZB8swnkapxPC`. This card prepares objectui#11466's V1 (draft PR #11512). objectui#11514, the dashboard producers, is blocked on it.

## The accept-set change

| surface | before (base `059bf1b5`) | after (head `ae16cff8`) |
|---|---|---|
| zod `ObjectChartSchema.chartType` (`@object-ui/types/zod`) | a local `z.enum` of 8: bar, column, horizontal-bar, line, area, pie, donut, scatter. Zod's default refusal. | `stripImportedDefaults(SpecChartTypeSchema).extract(OBJECT_CHART_FAMILIES, { error })`: the spec's 13 families plugin-charts draws. The refusal names the set. |
| authored bag `ObjectChartBlockSchema`, `properties.chartType` | the same member, by reference (8) | the same member, by reference (13) |
| TS `ObjectChartSchema['chartType']` | a literal union of the 8 | `Extract` of the spec's `ChartType` over the 13 |
| TS `ObjectChartBlockNode` (derived from the zod arm) | 8 | 13. A throwaway probe: `sankey` compiles and `gauge` is refused. |
| `specType` (the react tier's key) | the spec's `ChartTypeSchema`, by reference (20) | unchanged |

- **Newly accepted:** `funnel`, `treemap`, `sankey`, `combo`, `radar`.
- **Still refused:** `gauge`, `solid-gauge`, `metric`, `kpi`, `bullet`, `table`, `pivot`, and every off-spec spelling.
- **`.extract` is the by-reference spelling.** It throws when the module loads if the spec drops a member. A spec bump that adds a family declares nothing new here.

The refusal, read at head: code `invalid_value`, at path `properties.chartType` in the bag and `chartType` on the flat mirror. Its `values` are the 13. Message:

> `chartType` on an `object-chart` is one of bar, horizontal-bar, column, line, area, pie, donut, funnel, scatter, treemap, sankey, combo, radar (objectui#11513): the `@objectstack/spec` chart families this chart block draws. The spec's single-value and tabular families draw no chart here: write a single number as an `object-metric`, rows as an `object-data-table`, a cross-tab as an `object-pivot`.

Render time does not change. plugin-charts is read and probed only, and no renderer file is edited.

## Measurements (dispatch zone 2)

**H1, the installed spec.** The lockfile pins `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0, and `packages/types` resolves 17.5.0 (17.6.0 is not installed). Its `ChartTypeSchema.options`, read at runtime, are 20: bar, horizontal-bar, column, line, area, pie, donut, funnel, scatter, treemap, sankey, combo, gauge, solid-gauge, metric, kpi, bullet, radar, table, pivot.

**H2, what plugin-charts draws.** A throwaway probe (never committed) rendered an `object-chart` for each of the 20 families plus off-spec `sunburst`. It went through the real `SchemaRenderer`, `SchemaRendererProvider` and this package's registrations, with recharts' container fixed at 480x320. Each family was rendered in five spellings:

- flat inline rows;
- the authored `properties` bag;
- the dashboard producer's exact node (`objectName` + `aggregate` + `xAxisKey` + `series[{dataKey}]`, rows served by the data source's `aggregate`);
- `specType`;
- a dimensionless `dataset` node.

Controls:

- **Stability:** the whole matrix ran twice in one process. 0 of the 105 cells differed, after stripping the React `useId` in the chart's style tag.
- **Lit:** `bar` draws bar marks.
- **Dark:** `sunburst` draws the unknown-type note.

| family | `chartType` (flat, bag and producer arms) | class |
|---|---|---|
| bar, column | bar marks, categories on the x axis, one value axis | drawn |
| horizontal-bar | bar marks, categories on the y axis | drawn |
| line / area | line / area marks | drawn |
| pie, donut | pie sectors. The DOM cannot tell a donut's hole apart; the family value is pinned by objectui#7401's `normalizeChartSchema` row. | drawn |
| funnel | funnel trapezoids | drawn |
| scatter | scatter symbols | drawn |
| treemap | treemap cells | drawn |
| sankey | sankey nodes and links | drawn |
| combo | bar + line marks on two value axes (two series). One series draws its first mark on the two axes. | drawn |
| radar | radar polygon | drawn |
| gauge, solid-gauge, bullet, metric, kpi | `advanced-chart-single-value`: one number from row 0's first series. On the producer's grouped aggregate it is the first bucket's value (`1` of buckets 1/2/3). | substituted |
| table, pivot | `advanced-chart-tabular-notice` ("render it with the data-table / pivot components") | nothing |

The declared set is the 13 drawn families, a strict subset of the spec's 20.

**H3, by reference.** A strict subset, so `.extract` off `stripImportedDefaults(SpecChartTypeSchema)`. The wrap keeps objectui#8317's import-boundary census green, and the strip is reference-equal here because the enum carries no default. The subset is pinned against the spec, with the complement named, in `object-chart-families-11513.test.ts`. `specType` stays the spec's enum by identity, and that is pinned too.

**H4, readers of `ObjectChartSchema['chartType']`.** Each was measured with a type-check after the change (a type-checker census).

- **`ChartRendererProps.schema.chartType`** (plugin-charts): `ObjectChart` hands `ChartRenderer` a spread of the node. Its declared domain is exactly the 13, so it needs nothing. `@object-ui/plugin-charts` type-check is green. A reverse leg in that program, with throwaway `@ts-expect-error`s, left the `funnel` directive unused and the `gauge` one used, which proves it read the rebuilt `.d.ts`.
- **`chartTypeIgnoresCompareTo`** (`@object-ui/core`): it takes a `string`, so it needs nothing.
- **`FilterableComponentSchema`** in `DashboardRenderer`: it reads `filter`, so it needs nothing. `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` type-check is green.
- **`ObjectChartBlockNode` / `ObjectChartBlockSchema`:** they widen with the member by reference, so no edit.
- **Producers that widen with it:**
  - `DashboardRenderer` and `DashboardGridLayout` emit `widgetDispatch.SERIES_CHART_TYPES` (12 families, all inside the 13). Today they build the node untyped; objectui#11514 types them.
  - The list-view relays in `app-shell` `ObjectView`, `plugin-list` `ListView` and `plugin-view` `ObjectView` write `chartCfg.chartType || 'bar'` from `any`. The spec's list-view chart config extracts bar, line, pie, area and scatter, all declared. They need nothing, and plugin-list, plugin-view and app-shell type-checks are green.
- **Not readers:** `CHART_TYPE_MAP` in `DatasetWidget` feeds a bare `chart` node (`ChartRenderer`), not `ObjectChartSchema`. `WidgetConfigPanel`'s `CHART_TYPES` is the dashboard widget picker.

## V1 compile probe (objectui#11466, PR #11512, never committed from)

I added a throwaway detached worktree at the V1 tip `ff7f748e`, applied this branch's diff, and added a throwaway types test.

- It assigns the 12 producer families to `NonNullable` of `ObjectChartSchema['chartType']`.
- It builds an `ObjectChartSchema` node with `chartType: 'sankey'`.
- It assigns that node, and an inline `treemap` node, to V1's `DeclaredNode` with no cast.
- It holds a `gauge` node behind `@ts-expect-error`.

Results:

- `@object-ui/types` type-check is green.
- **Control leg:** the same tree with V1's own `objectql.ts` and `objectql.zod.ts` (the 8-family face) is red on exactly the producer list, the `sankey` node and the `treemap` node (TS2322). It is also red on this PR's two `Equal` assertions.
- **Deviation:** V1's base predates objectui#11366's jsdom pin, so `pnpm install` in that probe tree ran with `--config.engine-strict=false`. Only in the probe; the probe tree is removed.

## Pins

- **`packages/types/src/__tests__/object-chart-families-11513.test.ts`** (new):
  - Type level, read by `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`: TS = zod = the 13. Every declared family is a spec `ChartType`, and the declared and undeclared lists cover the spec. Two non-vacuity rows check that `Equal` can fail.
  - Runtime: the set read off the mirror is the 13. It is a strict subset of the installed spec, with the complement named. `specType` keeps its identity.
  - Each of the 13 parses in the bag on `safeValidateSchema` and on `StrictAnyComponentSchema`, and on the flat mirror.
  - Each undeclared spec family, plus `sunburst`, `Bar` and `bar-chart`, is refused at `properties.chartType` with `values` equal to the 13 and a message naming each of them. The flat mirror refuses at `chartType`, with a lit control.
- **`packages/plugin-charts/src/__tests__/object-chart-declared-families-11513.test.tsx`** (new):
  - Every family of the installed spec is authored as a bag document on the inline object path, parsed on both faces, and rendered through the real `SchemaRenderer`.
  - The pin is two-way: a family parses exactly when it draws a chart. A declared family must draw its own marks, so a family silently drawn as a bar fails. An undeclared one must render the number card or the tabular notice.
  - Lit control `bar`, dark control `sunburst`.
- **Re-judged fixtures:**
  - `object-chart-properties-bag-11276.test.ts`: the "outside the vocabulary" row and the flat-mirror refusal move from `radar` (now declared) to `gauge`. The TS twin equality pin now reads TS = zod; the members are held by the new file.
  - plugin-charts `ObjectChart.schemaAnchor-7946.test.ts`: its `@ts-expect-error` family moves from `radar` to `gauge`, with the reason in the directive.

## Reverse verification and ablation

- **Runtime ablation**, at committed `0703053b` (the mirror's blob is the same at head `ae16cff8`), through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (wrap mode, anchor hit 1 to 0, blob `04c4bbc2` to `9c207bd2`):
  - The mutation replaced the mirror's `.extract(OBJECT_CHART_FAMILIES, { error: OBJECT_CHART_FAMILY_REFUSAL })` with `.extract([... the old 8 ...])`.
  - Both new pins ran: 24 failed and 25 passed. The red rows are the 5 new families (parse and render, twice each), the set and subset rows, and every refusal row (its `values` became the 8). The 8 old families stayed green.
  - Restore was proven: blob equals `HEAD` `04c4bbc2`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
  - Direction: turned red, as expected.
- **Type-level:** the V1 control leg above is red on both `Equal` rows when the face reverts.
- **Docs:** `content/docs/plugins/plugin-charts.mdx`'s new typed snippet with `chartType: 'gauge'` fails `pnpm check:doc-snippets` (TS2322 at that block, 777 judged and 1 failed). Restore was proven the same way. So the block is on the gate's surface.

## Corpus re-judged

- **objectui:** no authored `object-chart` document names a family outside the old 8. `git grep` over `examples/`, `apps/`, `content/`, `skills/` and `packages/*/examples/` found one hit, `chart-examples.ts`'s `radar`, and that is a bare `chart` node.
- **objectstack showcase** (`examples/**`): its `object-chart` nodes use `bar`, `donut` and `area`. The react-tier ObjectChart block with `type="bar"` goes through `specType`, which is unchanged.
- **Runs:** `examples/schema-catalog` is green (40 files, 2259 tests). So are the 19 downstream test files that name `object-chart` (597 tests), across app-shell, core, plugin-dashboard, plugin-list, plugin-view, react and sdui-parser.

## Pending changesets read

I read every `.changeset/*.md` that names `chartType`, `object-chart`, `ObjectChartSchema` or a chart family (58 entries besides this PR's), and none is made false. The ones that state something about this key, left alone:

- `5927-zod-mirror-group-a-widenings.md` lists what that change added (`column`, `horizontal-bar`, `donut`). It is still the reading of that change.
- `objectchart-schema-anchor-7946.md`: "`chartType` must be the declared union" still holds.
- `10770-object-chart-react-tier-node.md`: `specType` is unchanged, and so is `chartType`'s optionality.
- `11276-object-chart-properties-bag.md`: "unchanged in shape" is about the key set, which does not move.
- `11468-bag-carrier-node-types.md`: `ObjectChartBlockNode` is "derived by reference", and it widened by that derivation.
- `10584-object-chart-series-describe.md`: it is about the per-series `chartType` override (bar / line / area), not this member.

`pnpm check:changeset-claims` named 30 entries by file name (`objectql.ts`, `objectql.zod.ts`). Each is about another key (forms, kanban, grid, drill-down, tree, gallery, the bare `chart` node's data model), so all were left alone.

## Gates

The source gates ran at `0703053b` and were re-run at head `ae16cff8`, which adds only `.md` / `.mdx`. The doc gates and suites ran at head `ae16cff8`.

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types run type-check`: exit 0. `@object-ui/plugin-charts` and `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`: exit 0 at head. `plugin-list`, `plugin-view` and `app-shell`: exit 0. The dependency closures were built first.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/`: 343 files, 9158 passed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-charts/`: 87 files, 1043 passed and 9 skipped. The skips are the existing `describe.runIf(DRIVEN)` in `AdvancedChartImpl.dateOnlyZone-10866.test.tsx`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run examples/schema-catalog/`: 40 files, 2259 passed.
- These gates exited 0 with their own verdict lines:
  - `pnpm check:doc-snippets` (777 of 777 judged, 0 failed) and `pnpm check:doc-examples` (every covered example compiles or fails as its ledger row says);
  - `pnpm check:doc-types`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` and `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`;
  - `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (0 new) and `pnpm check:control-bytes`;
  - `pnpm check:spec-symbols`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit` and `check:vi-mock-override-shape`;
  - `check:test-path-roots`, `check:self-import`, `check:doc-fences` and `check:pending-changeset-literals`;
  - `check:phantom-deps`, `check:installed-pin-claims`, `check:doc-example-ids` and `check:unreferenced-sources`.
- **Not reached:** `check:component-surface-parity` and `check:sdui-registration-pins`. No registration's inputs move, because `object-chart`'s registration declares no `chartType` input.
- **Lint, a declared narrowing:** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` ran over the 6 changed TS files, read as 6 entries in the JSON. It found 0 errors and 39 warnings, all `no-explicit-any`. Two are in the new plugin-charts pin's `vi.mock('recharts')` block, the sibling pattern. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` belongs to CI.

## Acceptance notes

1. **Found, not fixed here (plugin-charts is read-only for this card).** A spec single-value or tabular family named through `specType` silently draws a BAR chart. Through `chartType`, the same family draws a number or a notice.
   - Probe `specType` arm: `gauge`, `solid-gauge`, `metric`, `kpi`, `bullet`, `table` and `pivot` each drew bar marks on one value axis, with no note.
   - Both faces accept `{ "type": "object-chart", "properties": { "specType": "gauge", … } }` (measured on the built `dist`).
   - Mechanism: `normalizeChartSchema` reads `specType` but gates it to unset when it is not `RENDERABLE`. `ChartRenderer`'s `schema.chartType ?? spec.chartType` is then unset, and `AdvancedChartImpl` defaults to `bar`.
   - Seam: `spec:ChartConfigSchema.type (ChartTypeSchema) → runtime:normalizeChartSchema RENDERABLE gate, ChartRenderer chartType fallback | renderer:AdvancedChartImpl default bar`.
   - The report carries it for the seat to file.
2. **Found, not fixed here (the `chart` node, another schema).** `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`'s ChartSchema table lists `chartType` values ending in `"heatmap"`.
   - `safeValidateSchema({ type: 'chart', chartType: 'heatmap', … })` refuses it at `chartType` (`invalid_value`, measured).
   - The table also omits families the node accepts and draws (`funnel`, `treemap`, `sankey`, `combo`, `column`, `horizontal-bar`).
   - The report carries it for the seat.
3. **The substituted and nothing families on `chartType`** (H2) have no reach after this PR:
   - the face refuses them at `chartType`;
   - the dashboard routes the single-value families to the metric card and the tabular ones to the table and pivot (`widgetDispatch`);
   - the spec's list-view chart config extracts only bar, line, pie, area and scatter.
   Noted, not filed.
